name: Annual leave (วันหยุดพักผ่อนประจำปี)
authority: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.30: not less than 6 working days a year after one year of continuous service; the employer and employee may agree to carry untaken days forward (contract fact annual_leave_carry_forward_days, customer input); s.56 pays the days. s.67 as amended by LPA (No. 2) B.E. 2551: para 1 — when the employer terminates without a s.119 ground, the leave of the year of termination in proportion to the year served (6 × the days to the exit day ÷ the days of the year); para 2 — on any exit, including resignation and a s.119 dismissal, the accumulated untaken leave carried forward. The amended Thai text was read only in a secondary copy (https://legardy.com/thai-law/labor-law/labor-law-section-5); the Council of State translation shows para 1.

entitlement.days: service_months >= 12.0 ? (has(employment.exit_date) && employment.exit_date != "" && as_of != null && as_of >= employment.exit_date ? ((has(employment.exit_ground) && employment.exit_ground in ["DISMISSAL", "REDUNDANCY", "RETIREMENT", "END_OF_CONTRACT"] && !(has(employment.exit_facts) && employment.exit_facts != null && has(employment.exit_facts.section_119_ground) && employment.exit_facts.section_119_ground)) ? round(6.0 * (calendar_distance_days(employment.exit_date.substring(0, 4) + "-01-01", employment.exit_date) + 1.0) / calendar_distance_days(employment.exit_date.substring(0, 4) + "-01-01", add_years(employment.exit_date.substring(0, 4) + "-01-01", 1)), 0.01, "HALF_UP") : 0.0) : 6.0) : 0.0

name: Sick leave (ลาป่วย)
authority: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.32: leave for actual sickness; a medical certificate may be required for three working days or more; s.57: wages for up to 30 working days a year. s.32 para 3: days lost to a work injury or work illness, and maternity days, are not sick leave (WORK_INJURY_LEAVE, MATERNITY_LEAVE). Office of the Council of State English translation (https://www.vertic.org/media/National%20Legislation/Thailand/TH_Labor_Protection_Act.pdf).

name: Sick leave beyond 30 paid days
authority: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.32 with s.57: sick leave is not capped, but wages are owed for at most 30 working days a year; the further days are unpaid.

name: Personal business leave (ลากิจ)
authority: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.34: not less than 3 working days a year for necessary business; s.57/1: paid for up to 3 days a year.

name: Sterilisation leave (ลาเพื่อทำหมัน)
authority: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.33: leave for sterilisation and for the period a physician certifies; s.57 para 2: paid.

name: Military service leave (ลารับราชการทหาร)
authority: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.35: leave to be inspected, call-up or trained under the military service law; s.58: paid for up to 60 days a year.

name: Training leave (ลาฝึกอบรม)
authority: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.36: leave for training or development under the rules the Ministerial Regulation prescribes; the Act owes no wages for it.

name: Maternity leave, employer-paid days (ลาคลอด)
authority: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.41 (before the No. 9 amendment): up to 98 days for each pregnancy, including prenatal examination and holidays; s.59: wages for up to 45 days. Metered per pregnancy (entry.facts.event_id): the employer-paid days here, the rest as MATERNITY_LEAVE_SSO.

name: Maternity leave, days without employer pay
authority: The days of s.41 maternity leave beyond the employer's s.59 wages; 98 less 45 days. Social Security Act B.E. 2533 (1990) s.67: the insured mother receives the maternity cash benefit from the Social Security Fund (50% of wages for 90 days).

name: Traditional holidays (วันหยุดตามประเพณี)
authority: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.29: not less than 13 days a year including National Labour Day (1 May), announced in advance; a holiday falling on a weekly holiday is replaced on the next working day; s.56(2): paid.

name: Unpaid leave by agreement
authority: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.5 and s.70: wages are owed for work and for the paid leave the Act lists (ss.56-59); other leave agreed with the employer is unpaid.

name: Work-injury absence (WCF compensation)
authority: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.32 para 3: a day the employee cannot work through injury or sickness from work is not sick leave (Office of the Council of State English translation (https://www.vertic.org/media/National%20Legislation/Thailand/TH_Labor_Protection_Act.pdf)). WCA B.E. 2537 s.18(1): compensation of 70% of the monthly wage while unable to work for more than three days, paid by the Workmen's Compensation Fund for a registered employer (https://www.sso.go.th/wpr/download/download_by_pool_file/47436; SSO WCF guide "ค่าทดแทนร้อยละ 70 ของค่าจ้างรายเดือน" https://www.sso.go.th/wpr/assets/upload/files_storage/sso_th/21f9d80408a598636551a7c559cd7920.pdf); the employer pays no wage for the days. An entry raises the s.48 notice.

name: Temporary cessation of business (75% pay)
authority: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.75 as amended by LPA (No. 2) B.E. 2551: when the employer must temporarily cease all or part of the business for a reason other than force majeure, it pays at least 75% of the working-day wage for the whole period, and notifies the employees and the labour inspector in writing beforehand (the Council of State translation shows the earlier 50%; 75% from the amended Thai text, secondary copy https://legardy.com/thai-law/labor-law/labor-law-section-5). The unpaid 25% is deducted by NO_PAY_LEAVE.

name: Suspension pending investigation (at least 50% pay)
authority: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.116: suspension during an investigation only if the work rules or agreement allow, by written order, at most 7 days, paid at not less than 50% of the working-day wage; s.117: if the employee is cleared, the full wage for the period with 15% a year interest (adhoc SUSPENSION_BACK_PAY, LATE_PAYMENT_INTEREST). Office of the Council of State English translation (https://www.vertic.org/media/National%20Legislation/Thailand/TH_Labor_Protection_Act.pdf).
